evidence_type: Owner-requested fork of the open-source H1 Control app with direct LDAC quality controls; built, installed side-by-side and launched
fork_changes: Added CodecQuality.kt: LdacQuality values 1000-1003, association evaluator, SDK gate, and reflection setter for BluetoothA2dp.setCodecConfigPreference with the confirmed 9-arg constructor order.
Added CompanionAssociation.kt: system-consented, non-self-managed CompanionDeviceManager association flow.
Extended CodecMonitor with quality state, association refresh, one setter call and one read-back refresh; no retry loop or reconnect reapplication.
Extended MainScreen AudioQuality with four LDAC policy buttons, association button, requested-vs-observed state and explicit limitations.
Extended MainActivity with association callbacks and result handling.
Manifest adds uses-feature android.software.companion_device_setup (required); no privileged permission was added.
applicationId changed to dev.madhuraj.h1.fork so the owner's existing dev.madhuraj.h1 install and its data are untouched.
Bugfix: uses-feature companion setup declared required=true (PackageInfo.reqFeatures check), and associate() failures are caught instead of crashing the app
Bugfix 2: exact CDM feature constant is android.software.companion_device_setup, not the hardware-style name
On app open: refresh() brings up SPP link and sends one status query; manual Refresh button added to status card
Added last-button-event timestamp in UiState and Modes card; game/spatial now show when last reported
Added read-only RFCOMM channel 10 listener (Fast Pair) with reflection createRfcommSocket(10), logging under tag H1-10; no writes
Opt-in auto reapply: saved LDAC quality, OFF by default, guarded by association + LDAC + policy mismatch + 10s cooldown, one setter on link restore
Bugfix: move link-restored callback wiring from Application.init to onCreate; init ran before base context and crashed
Auto reapply fix: queue reapply until A2DP proxy returns after onStop
Temporary H1Auto/H1Codec logging added to trace auto-reapply path
Debug-only rawh intent extra writes verbatim bytes to RFCOMM ch1 for bounded protocol experiments
Removed raw-byte write debug hook after three bounded game-mode write candidates failed

build.method: Portable Windows Android SDK + Gradle 8.7 wrapper (Kotlin Multiplatform/Compose project), no global PATH change
build.sdk: platforms/android-34 and android-36, build-tools/34.0.0 and 36.0.0, platform-tools
build.signer_note: AGP debug key; differs from the owner's existing H1 Control signer (CN=H1 Control), which is why a side-by-side package was used.

install.existing_package_preserved: dev.madhuraj.h1 still installed with its original data
install.launch: dev.madhuraj.h1.fork/dev.madhuraj.h1.MainActivity started; no FATAL EXCEPTION or AndroidRuntime crash observed
actions_not_taken: No uninstall or data clear of the existing app
No association created by the agent
No LDAC quality button pressed by the agent
No codec change or headset command

limitations: The runtime quality change through this fork has not been exercised; it needs the owner to grant permission, associate, and press a quality button.
The Kotlin/JUnit tests in the original core were not run during this build.
The RFCOMM shell probe earlier failed; this fork uses its own transport and was only confirmed to launch without crashing.
Direct selection is version-qualified from AOSP snapshots, not guaranteed across OEM/Mainline builds.
privacy: No MAC address, serial, full logs or proprietary artifacts are published here.
